Class ProceduralPopulationGenerator

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.engines.tier2.theories.ProceduralPopulationGenerator
public final class ProceduralPopulationGenerator extends Object
Advanced Population Simulation & Density Generator.

Supports:

  1. Earth historical human density distributions across pivot eras (-100k BP to 1800 CE).
  2. Procedural tech-adapted human population distribution based on topographic relief, thermal/climate niche (Xu et al. 2020), freshwater/aquifer proximity, Zipf urban agglomeration (Zipf 1949; Gabaix 1999), and pressurized extraterrestrial pioneer outposts.
Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
